input.summary:
Implemented the full Task Management API as specified in the C4 architecture document. Here's what was built:

**Files created (8 source files + config):**

- `src/event-bus.ts` — In-memory pub/sub EventBus singleton. `publish(event, payload)` fans out to all subscribers synchronously. Errors in subscribers are caught and logged so one bad handler can't break others.

- `src/services/user-service.ts` — UserService with create/getById/getAll/update/delete. Owns its own `Map<string, User>`. Typed error classes (UserNotFoundError, UserValidationError).

- `src/services/project-service.ts` — ProjectService with full CRUD + addMember/removeMember (idempotent add). Owns its own `Map<string, Project>`.

- `src/services/task-service.ts` — TaskService with CRUD + assign + changeStatus. Enforces forward-only, one-step-at-a-time status transitions via an explicit allowed-transitions map (`todo→in-progress`, `in-progress→done`). Publishes `task.assigned` and `task.statusChanged` events to the bus.

- `src/services/comment-service.ts` — CommentService with create/getById/getByTask/delete. Accepts denormalised `taskTitle`, `authorName`, and `taskAssigneeId` fields (resolved by the router) so it can emit a rich `comment.added` event without calling other services directly.

- `src/services/notification-service.ts` — NotificationService that subscribes to `task.assigned`, `task.statusChanged`, and `comment.added` in its constructor. Creates Notification records with appropriate messages. Exposes getByUser/markAsRead. Self-comment suppression (no notification when assignee comments on their own task).

- `src/router.ts` — Single HTTP entry point. Parses path segments, query params, and JSON bodies. Maps all 26 routes from the spec. The only place that coordinates multiple services (e.g., resolving task/user context before creating a comment). Maps domain errors to 400/404/500 HTTP responses.

- `src/main.ts` — Creates and starts the HTTP server (configurable via PORT/HOST env vars, defaults to 127.0.0.1:3000).

- `src/demo.ts` — End-to-end demo that boots a server on port 3001 and exercises all 26 routes with 81 assertions covering happy paths, error cases, event-driven notifications, status transition enforcement, and delete/cleanup flows.

**Key architectural constraints respected:**
1. No direct service-to-service calls — all cross-service communication via EventBus
2. Each service owns its own data Map exclusively
3. All HTTP handling in router only; services are plain TS classes
4. Forward-only status transitions enforced with explicit transition map
5. Zero npm runtime dependencies — only Node.js built-ins (http, crypto, url)
6. One file per service as required

**Test results: 81/81 assertions pass ✔**
